repository_summary: Scrapy is a fast high-level web crawling and web scraping framework, used to crawl websites and extract structured data from their pages.
change_summary: Pull request 6546 adds minimum and maximum TLS version settings as a replacement for the legacy TLS method setting. It deprecates non-default uses of DOWNLOADER_CLIENT_TLS_METHOD and historical TLS module constants, and removes that legacy setting from the HTTPX download handler.
